attchmntText: SPL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: SPL Industries Limited filed extracts of newspaper advertisements for dissemination of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on 12 November 2026 and subjected to limited review by statutory auditors. AlphaGrep Securities Private Limited filed extracts of unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. These results were approved by the Board of Directors on 12 November 2026. Maharashtra Seamless Limited filed extracts of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. Ravi Kumar Distilleries Limited filed extracts of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026.

attchmntText: SPL Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SPL Industries Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the half year ended 30 September 2026 during a Board Meeting on 13 November 2026. The company reported a net profit of 19.83 lakhs for the period, compared to a net profit of 111.27 lakhs in the corresponding previous period. Revenue from operations stood at 3,490.73 lakhs, up from 3,161.15 lakhs previously. Total income from operations was 4,329.68 lakhs. Earnings per equity share were 0.38. The results were reviewed by statutory auditors Raghu Nath Rai & Co. The company has a paid-up equity share capital of 2,900.00 lakhs. Total assets as at 30 September 2026 were 22,670.44 lakhs. Total equity was 21,715.89 lakhs. Net cash from operating activities for the half year was negative 454.03 lakhs.
